claims.scope: AtomWallet 77-byte signature validation and UserOperation time-window enforcement

preconditions.text: A relayer/bundler holds a valid 77-byte signed UserOperation for AtomWallet.; The last 12 bytes of the 77-byte signature encode validUntil and validAfter as metadata.; getUserOpHash hashes the UserOperation excluding the signature field.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: The validUntil/validAfter time window must be covered by the owner's signature so it cannot be altered without invalidating the signature.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Because AtomWallet.execute can perform arbitrary calls, unauthorized token transfers, approvals, or other wallet actions can occur at attacker-chosen times.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The relayer is not the signer and rewrites the suffix without the signer's authorization.
AtomWallet.execute can perform arbitrary calls once a UserOperation passes validation.
The 77-byte signature consists of a 65-byte rawSignature plus a 12-byte validUntil/validAfter suffix.

limitations: Concrete validUntil/validAfter values of the original signed operation are not specified; the window relation is bound as a Boolean.
The claim formalizes only i_unauthorized_actions; i_window_not_enforced and i_stale_execution are not covered by this plan.
